method: Whole-file manual reading of Italian catalog; pinned source bytes reverified; v91 structural parity evidence retained.
findings: Probabili duplicati, Prefisso hash and Campione hash distinguish probability, prefix display and sampling; advanced option explicitly says partial hashes above64MiB. No full-content equality inferred.

Recovery result asks to verify file data; recoverable and possibly recoverable states remain distinct, and same-source-volume warning states overwrite risk. Labels do not prove restoration correctness.

Auto-elevation label says system startup rather than simply application startup, potentially misleading about autostart behavior. Parent/child navigation rendered primario/secondario can obscure tree relationships.

Storage tier list uses intenso/medio/base/archive and current-hot-tier caption livello elevato; this is less direct than hot/cool/cold naming. Cost estimates remain modeled values, not provider prices.
Sparsify retains sparse wording, compression is separate, glob differs from regex, and hardlinks/symbolic links/junctions have distinct labels.
Rows/Squarified style names localized Righe/Squadrato in both menu and style list, maintaining correspondence. MSI it-IT/1040/1252 declarations require actual installer checks.
limits: No rendered layout, mnemonic conflict, installer or Windows runtime verification. No foreign production code adopted.
